  * #### [ Scope Infection Lawsuit ][8]
    
    [Surgical-Scope-Infection-Lawsuit]
    Patients across the United States have filed medical scope infection lawsuits after contaminated
    endoscopes and duodenoscopes allegedly transmitted dangerous bacterial infections during
    procedures such as ERCP, colonoscopy, and other endoscopic treatments.
    
    #### [ Spinal Cord Stimulator Lawsuit ][9]
    
    [Spinal-Cord-Stimulation-Lawsuit]
    Spinal cord stimulator lawsuits allege that implanted pain devices malfunctioned, migrated, or
    caused nerve damage, often forcing patients to undergo revision or removal surgery.
    
    #### [ Chlorpyrifos Parkinson’s Disease Lawsuit ][10]
    
    [Chlorpyrifos Parkinson’s Disease Lawsuit]
    Chlorpyrifos lawsuits are being investigated for individuals diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease
    after direct, residential, occupational or Gulf War pesticide exposure.
    
    #### [ Ozempic Lawsuit ][11]
    
    [Ozempic Lawsuit]
    Lawyers are pursuing Ozempic lawsuits, Wegovy lawsuits and Mounjaro lawsuits over gastroparesis
    or stomach paralysis, which can leave users with long-term gastrointestinal side effects
    
    #### [ Suboxone Tooth Decay Lawsuit ][12]
    
    [Suboxone Lawsuits Over Tooth Decay and Tooth Loss]
    Lawsuits are being pursued by users of Suboxone who experienced tooth loss, broken teeth or
    required dental extractions. Settlement benefits may be available.
    
    #### [ Depo-Provera Lawsuit ][13]
    
    [Depo-Provera Brain Tumor Lawsuit]
    Depo-Provera lawsuits are being investigated for women who developed meningioma brain tumors
    after receiving Depo-Provera birth control shots, claiming that Pfizer failed to adequately
    disclose side effects.
    
    #### [ Hair Relaxer Lawsuit ][14]
    
    [Hair Relaxer Cancer Lawsuit]
    Regular exposure to chemicals in hair relaxer may cause uterine cancer, ovarian cancer and other
    injuries. Women diagnosed with cancer may be eligible for settlement benefits.
    
    #### [ Nitrous Oxide Lawsuit ][15]
    
    Individuals who suffered harm, or families who lost a loved one after using nitrous oxide
    products may be eligible for financial compensation through a nitrous oxide lawsuit.
    
    #### [ Breast Mesh Lawsuit ][16]
    
    [Internal-Bra-Lawsuit-Breast-Mesh-Lawsuits]
    Lawyers are investigating breast mesh lawsuits for women who suffered infections, pain, or
    implant failure from internal bra implants used in breast reconstruction surgery.
    
    #### [ Bard PowerPort Lawsuit ][17]
    
    [Bard PowerPort Lawsuit Lawyers]
    Serious and life-threatening injuries have been linked to problems with Bard PowerPort. Lawsuits
    are now being pursued by individuals who suffered injuries from the implantable port catheter
    fracturing or migrating.

high quality ingredients for more than 75+ years. Today, Actus is a top manufacturer of whey
proteins, milk proteins, casein and caseinate products. In addition to offering core ingredients
found in best-selling products across the grocery store, Actus offers a wide range of custom
ingredients catering to categories from infant nutrition to geriatric nutrition products.

 Whether your customers are elite athletes, busy parents or those who need the best nutrition, Actus

stand out on grocery store shelves.

# Nourishing life & growth

About Ausnutria

Ausnutria aims to make a contribution to the availability of healthy and nutritious infant formula,
so that parents and caretakers who rely on the use of infant formula for their child have access to
high-quality products. With our high-quality products and services, we stimulate the business growth
of our customers, as well as the healthy development of children.

[More about Ausnutria][49]

## Discover our brands

Kabrita
Kabrita

Kabrita infant nutrition combines the natural benefits of Dutch goat milk with a modern composition
of ingredients that meets the latest scientific insights.

Your brand
Your brand

Do you want to market you own brand infant formula? We support professional customers with our
experience, expertise and production capacity.

CBM
CBM

Ausnutria offers a range of goat milk ingredients under the brand name CBM. Besides full cream and
skimmed milk powder, the CBM range includes butter, cream and other specialty products. The goat
milk ingredients are used by food companies worldwide.

Our customers and consumers can rely on our expertise founded on over 100 years of experience in the
dairy industry. [More about our infant formula][50]

## Our expertise

Ausnutria has more than 125 years of experience in the production of dairy and 70 years of
experience in developing and producing infant formula.

[
More about our expertise][51]
70+Years of experience in infant formula

## Our responsibility

Ausnutria pursues its mission with due consideration to the society in which it operates. In this
respect Ausnutria not only focuses on opportunities, but also on its responsibilities. Growing
children are vulnerable. Access to the right nutrition is essential for their development.

[
More about our responsibility][52]
Food safety is our number one priority
Our social mission is to produce high-quality dairy products for current ánd future generations,
with respect for the world around us. [More about sustainability][53]

## Ausnutria’s sustainable future

### Better life

We commit ourselves to a safe workplace for our employees and to a society in which everyone can
flourish and make optimal use of their talents.

### Better nutrition

We continuously embrace innovation to create high-quality nutritional products that promote a
healthy life for all.

### Better environment

We strive to implement the most environmentally friendly ways of production and reduce our
ecological footprint.

Our social mission is to produce high-quality dairy products for current ánd future generations,
with respect for the world around us. [More about sustainability][54]

## We serve the international market from our base in the Netherlands

Our Dutch headquarters and our four production sites are located here. From the Netherlands we
export our products to more than 60 countries worldwide. In doing so, we work together with our
sister company, subsidiaries and distributors in a.i. the Middle East, Russia, the United States,
Europe, Mexico and China.

Our Dutch organization, together with its sister organizations in China and Oceania, is part of
Ausnutria Dairy Corporation Ltd., based in Hong Kong and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
Together we form the Ausnutria group.

[
More about our locations][55]

# Nourishing life & growth

About Ausnutria

Ausnutria aims to make a contribution to the availability of healthy and nutritious infant formula,
so that parents and caretakers who rely on the use of infant formula for their child have access to
high-quality products. With our high-quality products and services, we stimulate the business growth
of our customers, as well as the healthy development of children.

[More about Ausnutria][49]

## Discover our brands

Kabrita
Kabrita

Kabrita infant nutrition combines the natural benefits of Dutch goat milk with a modern composition
of ingredients that meets the latest scientific insights.

Your brand
Your brand

Do you want to market you own brand infant formula? We support professional customers with our
experience, expertise and production capacity.

CBM
CBM

Ausnutria offers a range of goat milk ingredients under the brand name CBM. Besides full cream and
skimmed milk powder, the CBM range includes butter, cream and other specialty products. The goat
milk ingredients are used by food companies worldwide.

Our customers and consumers can rely on our expertise founded on over 100 years of experience in the
dairy industry. [More about our infant formula][50]

## Our expertise

Ausnutria has more than 125 years of experience in the production of dairy and 70 years of
experience in developing and producing infant formula.

[
More about our expertise][51]
70+Years of experience in infant formula

## Our responsibility

Ausnutria pursues its mission with due consideration to the society in which it operates. In this
respect Ausnutria not only focuses on opportunities, but also on its responsibilities. Growing
children are vulnerable. Access to the right nutrition is essential for their development.

[
More about our responsibility][52]
Food safety is our number one priority
Our social mission is to produce high-quality dairy products for current ánd future generations,
with respect for the world around us. [More about sustainability][53]

## Ausnutria’s sustainable future

### Better life

We commit ourselves to a safe workplace for our employees and to a society in which everyone can
flourish and make optimal use of their talents.

### Better nutrition

We continuously embrace innovation to create high-quality nutritional products that promote a
healthy life for all.

### Better environment

We strive to implement the most environmentally friendly ways of production and reduce our
ecological footprint.

Our social mission is to produce high-quality dairy products for current ánd future generations,
with respect for the world around us. [More about sustainability][54]

## We serve the international market from our base in the Netherlands

Our Dutch headquarters and our four production sites are located here. From the Netherlands we
export our products to more than 60 countries worldwide. In doing so, we work together with our
sister company, subsidiaries and distributors in a.i. the Middle East, Russia, the United States,
Europe, Mexico and China.

Our Dutch organization, together with its sister organizations in China and Oceania, is part of
Ausnutria Dairy Corporation Ltd., based in Hong Kong and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
Together we form the Ausnutria group.

[
More about our locations][55]

0800+ colleagues who are committed to healthy growth from our locations in the Netherlands
0Affiliated goat farmers, who provide us with fresh goat milk every day
We are all over the world
